instruction: Pull over beside the dark red SUV on the right.
paraphrases: Stop next to the nearby red SUV on the right.|Park beside the prominent right-hand red SUV.

instruction: Pass the white car at the left edge, then stop near the small white car ahead.
paraphrases: Go past the left-edge white car and stop by the white car in front.|After the white car on the left, pull over near the distant white car ahead.

instruction: Stop beside the pedestrian next to the white SUV on the right.
paraphrases: Pull over by the pedestrian near the right-hand white SUV.|Park next to the pedestrian beside the white SUV.

instruction: Stop beside the white truck on the left—correction, stop near the beige sedan on the right.
paraphrases: Take the white truck on the left—rather, the beige sedan on the right.|Stop near the beige sedan on the right, not the white truck on the left.
